sequence.description: Monotonic content publication sequence (listing watermarks use it).

lance_version.description: Exact Lance version, including its FTS index.

maintenance_completed_at.description: Last completed maintenance, inherited by ordinary publications.

settings.description:
The namespace's settings as this version was built with them. The reader
refuses a version that differs from the policy's, apart from
`attribute_indexes`, which here holds the indexes that are built.

merge_pair_rows.description:
Of each vector index with more live segments than `writer serve` leaves
alone (64), the smallest sum of the rows of two neighboring segments, in
fragment order. `writer serve` compares it with the rows one merge step
may rewrite, to know whether a merge has anything to do.

files.description: Immutable files of this version, relative to the dataset root.

lineage.description: Exact Lance transactions made by the leased holder.

identity.description: Pins immutable membership/container inputs through the identity artifact.

cursor_rewinds.description: Immutable restore rewind marker paths; visible only through this publication.

incarnation.description:
The incarnation of the namespace that published this version, copied
from the serving head.

envelope_evidence.description:
Which envelopes this publication and every older one committed or
rejected, so that the newest manifest is enough to tell.

chain_applied.description:
The newest chained envelope of each source and kind (content and
permissions) that this publication and every older one resolved. The
committer walks the chain of the cursor back to it.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract schema version `<major>.<minor>`. Readers accept any minor of their major and reject other majors.

retrieval.description: Candidate depths, fusion weight and batched output bounds.

composition.description: Document slots: fusion first, then further unique dense and lexical hits.

fts_positions.description: Token positions in the `searchable_text` index; a `phrase` condition needs them.

analyzer.description:
How the full-text index of `searchable_text` cuts a text into terms: the
tokenizer, the language, the stop words and the other settings of an
attribute's analyzer. The index, the highlights and the excerpts of a hit
all use it. Absent: the `simple` tokenizer, lowercase, tokens under 40 bytes,
no stemming, stop words or folding. Fixed when the namespace is created.

dense_rq_bits.description: RaBitQ bits per dimension of the dense vector index.

dense_partition_rows.description: Target rows per partition of the dense vector index.

dense_metric.description:
The distance the dense index and the rescoring measure, fixed for the
life of the namespace: `cosine`, `squared_l2` or `dot`.

dense_element.description:
The element type the vectors are stored in, fixed for the life of the
namespace: `f16` or `f32`.

attributes.description:
Typed attributes declared for a new namespace: name to `string`, `int`,
`float`, `bool` or `datetime`. Each is a nullable column with its own
index. A request that changes the schema adds attributes and never
changes or removes one.

attribute_indexes.description:
The attributes whose indexes differ from the default (the scalar index
of the attribute's type): `index = false` leaves the attribute to a scan
of the table, `full_text` and `ngram` add a text index to a `string`
(`full_text` also to an array of strings, one document per element),
and `analyzer` sets how the full-text index cuts a text into terms. An
index switched on is built by the next maintenance.

vectors.description:
Named vector attributes declared for a new namespace, fixed for its
life: name to `dimensions` and, optionally, the `string` attribute
(`from`) the writer embeds the vector from. Each is a nullable column
with its own vector index. The built-in `vector` is not declared: it
stays the default attribute of every namespace. Needs `write_api`.

write_api.description:
Present: the writer serves `POST /v1/namespaces/{namespace}/documents`,
and a namespace created from this file or through that route takes its
documents only from the API (no `[[sources]]`). The keys are the
defaults of a new namespace; an existing one keeps its own.

NamespaceSettings.description:
The index and retrieval settings a namespace is created with and keeps for
its life. The process configuration only supplies them when the namespace is
created; every reader and writer afterwards takes them from the namespace's
policy artifact, which each content manifest pins.

fingerprint.description:
Digest of the model settings and text transformation (prefix,
normalization) that keys the embedding cache.

EmbeddingIdentity.description: The embedding identity bound into envelopes and publications.

EmbeddingSettings.description: Vector-affecting settings recorded with a publication's model/dimensions.

EmbeddingApiStyle.description: Fixed protocol identity recorded in persisted embedding settings.

EmbeddingRoles.description:
Persisted role transformations accept future minor-version additions.
Configuration uses strict types at its TOML boundary.

candidates.description: Authorized composed documents to rerank before the request limit.

weight.description: Logistic population-z score blend; 1 uses raw reranker order, 0 fusion order.

text_chars.description:
Optional per-candidate text bound in characters: send the window with the
most distinct query terms instead of the whole record. Absent sends the
whole record.

RerankSettings.description:
What of a reranker decides results: recorded in the namespace when it is
created. The endpoint, credential, spend caps and deadline stay process
configuration ([`RerankConfig`]).

rescore_depth.description:
Float16 candidate refinement. Unset, it starts at four times the dense
lane depth and, with one-bit codes, grows with the rows the probes inspect.

source_cap.description: Soft cap per composition bucket; zero disables it.

max_documents.description: Total unique documents in a multi-query response.

RetrievalConfig.description: Retrieval policy bound into each publication's ranking identity.

oneOf.description:
Expand when the exact distance gap, in the units of the namespace's
metric, at the retained boundary is small.

Composition.description: Operator composition; its values are bound into the retrieval policy identity.

language.description:
Stems the terms and removes the stop words of the language. Absent: no
stemming, and no stop words but `stop_words`.

stop_words.description:
The stop words to remove instead of the language's: compared with a term
after it is lowercased and stemmed.

max_token_length.description:
Tokens of this many UTF-8 bytes or more are dropped: a token is kept when it is
shorter than this.

ngram_max_length.description: Only with the `ngram` tokenizer; not below `ngram_min_length`.

prefix_only.description: Only with the `ngram` tokenizer: only the n-grams that start a token.

Analyzer.description:
The settings of a full-text index that decide which terms a text yields.
A text is lowercased always. Changing them on an attribute changes its index,
which the writer's maintenance rebuilds while the old one keeps serving; the
analyzer of `searchable_text` is fixed when the namespace is created.

oneOf.description:
Runs of letters and digits: a text in Chinese, Japanese or Korean is one
token per run of such characters.
Runs of characters that are not white space.

Unicode word segmentation, which finds the words of a text in Chinese or
Japanese by a dictionary.

Every substring of a token between `ngram_min_length` and
`ngram_max_length` characters, or only the ones that start it.

Tokenizer.description: The way a text is cut into tokens.

Language.description: A language with a stemmer and a stop-word list.

DenseMetric.description:
The distance of the dense index. Lance's IVF_RQ index supports all three on
16-bit and 32-bit float vectors. Its `_distance` is lower for a nearer row:
`cosine` is one minus the cosine similarity, `squared_l2` the squared
Euclidean distance and `dot` one minus the dot product.

DenseElement.description:
The element type of a stored vector. A 16-bit float halves the vector
column; a 32-bit one keeps the numbers the caller sent.

oneOf.description: An RFC 3339 string in requests, stored as UTC microseconds.
A UUID as 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits in requests, stored in 16 bytes.
Base64 in requests. Stored, never filtered, sorted or indexed.
A list of values of one scalar type, written `{"array": "string"}`.

ElementType.description: The type of the elements of an array: every scalar type but `bytes`.

AttributeIndex.description:
The indexes an attribute has: the scalar one unless it says otherwise, and a
full-text or an n-gram index when it asks for one. An attribute without an
index is still filtered and sorted: by a scan of the table. The settings of
the analyzer belong to the full-text index and are only set with it; an
index without one takes the namespace's text analyzer settings.

dimensions.description: Numbers in each vector of the column, a multiple of 8 from 8 to 8192.

from.description:
A declared `string` attribute whose value the writer embeds, with the
namespace's embedding model, into a row that brings no vector of its
own for this attribute. The model's dimensions must be `dimensions`.
Without it, rows carry the vector or leave it null.

multi.description:
A row holds a list of vectors of `dimensions` numbers, not one, and a
search of the attribute takes several query vectors as one query: Lance
scores a row by the sum, over the query vectors, of the best cosine
similarity to any vector of the row. Only a namespace whose `dense_metric`
is `cosine` offers it, and a row's vectors are not embedded from text
(no `from`).

VectorAttribute.description:
A named vector attribute: a nullable column of its own, of vectors of one
dimension, with a vector index of its own. The metric, the element type and
the index settings are the namespace's. The built-in `vector` column is not
one: it is the default attribute of every namespace and is not declared.

text_attribute.description:
The key of a row that holds its text: embedded, full-text indexed and
returned as the content of the record. It is not a typed attribute and
not one of `attributes`.

open.description:
`false`: a row is readable by the reader tokens it names, and a row
that names none by nobody. `true`: every authenticated subject of the
deployment reads every row.

WriteApiSettings.description:
How a namespace written through the HTTP API stores and shows its rows. Fixed
for the life of the namespace.

partitions.description:
The IVF partitions of the model of a vector index segment
(`ivf_rq`); absent for every other kind.

IndexIdentity.description: One index of the published version.

FileRef.description: A file with its size, for accounting and the mirror.

recovery_version.description: A recovery Restore supersedes unpublished history before this boundary.

CommitLineage.description: Publication-local fencing evidence, immutable with the content manifest.

LineageTransaction.description: Identity of one actual Lance transaction, never an inferred version range.

object.description: Object key, relative to the namespace root.

GenerationPointer.description: Points at one immutable generation of a policy or identity artifact.

applied_since.description: Envelopes committed after the checkpoint, this publication's included.

rejected_since.description: Envelopes rejected after the checkpoint, this publication's included.

EnvelopeEvidence.description:
The envelope outcomes of a publication chain up to one manifest: an
immutable checkpoint of the older ones, and the few since.

rows.description: Live rows, deleted ones not counted.

logical_bytes.description: Bytes of the data files of those rows, indexes and deletion files not counted.

first_published_at.description:
When the namespace's first content publication was committed, carried
forward by every later one.

PublicationStats.description: The size of a published version and when its namespace was first published.
